title: North Korea denies involvement in $6 B Binance crypto platform heist

blocks.text: North Korea denied a U.S. accusation that it was involved in the theft of assets worth more than $6 billion from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange platform last week, state media reported Tuesday. In a statement dated Monday, Kim Yo Jong, the sister of the country’s leader Kim Jong Un, dismissed the accusation by the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation as “absurd rhetoric” that is “nothing new,” according to the Korean Central News Agency. “The FBI is trying to brand the DPRK as a ‘cyber criminal state,'” Kim Yo Jong said, describing it as a “grave political provocation” against the country.
